issues: Only the 2022-23 Program of Studies (14 pages, Word->PDF) is public; no 2023-24 through 2026-27 edition found. It predates the Class of 2027+ graduation requirements shown in the school profile (English 4 credits + 1 Language credit vs. English 5 credits), so course list/requirements may be stale. A second link labeled 'Program of Studies 2022-2023' on the Students page points to a Proctor (PrHS) handbook. Grad requirements live in the handbook and school profile, not a separate doc.
